{{recipesummary|category=Cookie recipes|yield=Makes about a dozen and a half|time=½ hour|difficulty=1}}
{{recipe}}

'''Peanut butter cookies''' are one of the most popular kinds of cookies. Add lemon zest for flavor.

== Ingredients ==
* 110 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]] (120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]] / ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] / 4 [[Cookbook:Ounce|oz]]) [[Cookbook:Peanut Butter|peanut butter]]
* 110 g (120 ml / ½ cup / 4 oz) white [[Cookbook:Granulated Sugar|granulated sugar]]
* 110 g (120 ml / ½ cup / 4 oz) [[Cookbook:Brown Sugar|brown sugar]]
* 110 g (120 ml / ½ cup / 4 oz) [[Cookbook:butter|butter]] or [[Cookbook:margarine|margarine]], melted
* 1 [[Cookbook:egg|egg]]
* ½ [[Cookbook:teaspoon|teaspoon]] [[Cookbook:vanilla|vanilla]] essence
* 280 g (300 ml / 1 ¼ cup / 10 oz) [[Cookbook:flour|all-purpose flour]]
* ¼ teaspoon [[Cookbook:salt|salt]]
* ¾ teaspoon [[Cookbook:Baking Soda|baking soda]]

== Procedure ==
# Start by preheating [[Cookbook:Oven|oven]] to [[Cookbook:Oven temperatures|180°C (350°F / gas mark 4)]].
# [[Cookbook:Creaming|Cream]] together sugars, melted butter, egg, and vanilla until creamy and smooth.
# Combine flour, peanut butter, salt, and baking soda in the mixture from step 2.
# After the mixture is complete, flatten small pieces into cookie shapes with a fork and place on an ungreased [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|baking sheet]] at least 2 inches apart.
# [[Cookbook:Baking|Bake]] in the preheated oven for 8–10 minutes, or until golden brown.
# Pull out of the oven and allow to cool.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* If low on brown sugar, combine the white sugar and 1 tablespoon of [[Cookbook:Molasses|molasses]] together.
* To give a sparkly look, dip cookie in step 4 on a small saucer sprinkled with sugar.
* Smooth peanut butter works much better than chunky.
* To flatten with a fork, press the tines of the fork across the cookie and then repeat going in the other direction to give a criss-cross pattern.
* For the alternate recipe (see below), you can use peanut oil instead of vegetable oil.
